sentences.en: She has diabetes and so they chopped off her feet.
sentences.zh: 她患有糖尿病，因此他们不得不截掉了她的双脚。

sentences.en: Sami chopped off his father's penis with a kitchen knife.
sentences.zh: 萨米用一把厨房刀割掉了他父亲的阴茎。

sentences.en: The Canadian chopped down the tree with an ax.
sentences.zh: 那个加拿大人用斧头砍倒了那棵树。
